t: URLinspector: Pole-Vaulting Over Mental Blocks in the AI-First Web
s: This article details the practical development of URLinspector, a tool for AI-first web SEO auditing, emphasizing sequential workflows inherited from FAQuilizer and overcoming development 'mental blocks' through philosophical principles like Gall's Law and persona modeling.
sub: Sequential workflow design in Python for SEO tools
Overcoming development mental blocks via re-contextualization and philosophical principles
URLinspector tool development and its relation to FAQuilizer
The 'Tuvok and Neelix' persona for balanced problem-solving
Gall's Law and Conway's Law in system design simplification
